note: Anytime TD on 24 of 33 feature families (236 of 318 columns) — K=25 minus build_vegas_features. Seed-averaged Top-1 +2.21pp vs the full set (p=0.007, 5 of 5 seeds) and +0.57pp over K=25 head to head (p=0.183, 4 of 5 seeds). first TD unchanged at 318.
justification: Top-5 -0.73pp (-2.17 se) is a real and slightly larger cost than K=25's -0.53pp, accepted for the same reason: the product goal is naming the most likely scorer, which Top-1 and Top-3 read and Top-5 does not. The families dropped are all team-or-game level (spread, total, implied team total, is_favorite) and `make diagnose` shows the team is almost never the discriminator for Top-1.
